Market today: Mixed signals are in play. While tech and chip names like Nvidia saw a premarket bounce after a selloff, rising Treasury yields and recession warnings from Bill Ackman suggest underlying caution. Your leveraged positions will amplify any market moves.

Your holdings: Most of your book is flashing "SELL" with deep losses, especially SOXL (-86.26%), MUU (-74.08%), and SPAL (-54.99%). These leveraged ETFs are decaying, and margin amplifies these drops, making them particularly painful. CRWD is a "TRIM" but still up 31.16%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any further Fed commentary, as these directly impact growth stock valuations. Also, monitor Nvidia's price action given the recent positive news.

Bottom line: With so many positions deep in the red and on margin, managing risk and respecting stops is paramount.
plays: Respect your stops on all "SELL" positions immediately. SPY, QQQ, SMH, and several leveraged ETFs are trading well below their stated stops, indicating significant risk that needs to be addressed.
Consider trimming CRWD to lock in some profits, given its "TRIM" status and 31.16% gain. This can reduce overall portfolio risk.
NVDD shows a scanner LONG setup (entry 47.17-47.08, stop 46.84). Nvidia news is positive today, making this a potential new buy.
